newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia allocates 290,400-bpd crude for March.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia allocates 290,400-bpd crude for March.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina has allocated about 290,400 barrels-per-day (bpd) of crude for export in March, little changed from 290,600-bpd in February, traders said on Wednesday.
The Minas allocation for March was 94,300-bpd compared with 90,600-bpd in February. Duri allocation was 45,700-bpd from 46,000-bpd in February.
Traders said they were surprised at the relatively low allocation for Minas and Duri owing to the expected turnaround starting February 22 of the 120,000-bpd Dumai refinery.
The refinery uses Minas for about 70 percent of its feedstock and Duri for the rest, leading traders to expect Minas allocations of well above 100,000-bpd for March.
However, they emphasised that the allocation represented the official allocation, suggesting that further allocations might be made at a later date.
